title: The Cloud Sandwich Mix-Up
markdown:
Flora the sheep and Milo the donkey loved Sunny Meadow School. It was always sunny and full of giggles. Today was special: lunch day! Penelope Quill, who helped with lunch, wrote the menu on the blackboard with wiggly letters.

Flora and Milo trotted over, their tummies rumbling. “What does it say?” Flora whispered.

Milo tilted his head. “Hmm,” he brayed. “It looks like… Cloud Sandwiches!” Flora giggled. Eating fluffy clouds! Yum!

They skipped to Grandpa Moss’s cozy burrow. Grandpa Moss, a wise badger, polished his spectacles. “Cloud sandwiches?” he chuckled. “Clouds are made of water, little ones. We can’t eat them!”

Milo’s ears drooped. “But the blackboard said so!” He felt a little worry. “What if we can’t have lunch?”

“Let’s take another peek,” Grandpa Moss smiled kindly.

Back at school, Penelope beamed. “Are you excited for lunch?”

Flora pointed a hoof at the blackboard. “We thought you were making cloud sandwiches!”

Penelope giggled, a sound like little bells. “Oh, my dears! See this swirly letter here?” She picked up chalk. “This is a ‘c’ for cauliflower! Cauliflower sandwiches!” She carefully added a clear ‘f’.

Flora and Milo looked closely. Oh! It wasn’t a cloud at all. It was c-a-u-l-i-f-l-o-w-e-r!

“Cauliflower!” Milo’s ears perked up. “I love cauliflower!”

“Me too!” Flora wagged her tail so hard it wiggled her whole body. “Much tastier than clouds!”

Soon, all the friends were eating warm, yummy cauliflower sandwiches. The sun dappled through the trees. Later, snuggled safe and warm in Grandpa Moss’s burrow, Flora and Milo felt happy and full. Milo nudged Flora. “I’m so glad it’s cauliflower!” he whispered. Flora smiled, her tummy feeling perfectly happy.
characters: Flora (a sheep), Milo (a donkey), Moss (a grandfather)
author: StoryGen Community
